aggregationContract.indicatorToDimension: D_rd = sum_j(alpha_jd * normalizedPressure_rj); within each dimension sum(alpha_jd)=1
aggregationContract.dimensionToOverall: S_r = sum_d(W_d * D_rd); sum(W_d)=1; effectiveIndicatorWeight_j = W_d * alpha_jd
aggregationContract.selectedRule: W_d=1/6 for every dimension; alpha_jd=1/n_d for every frozen indicator in that dimension
aggregationContract.singletonRule: For overall IRBI and district IKLH, alpha=1 and dimension score equals the unchanged normalized indicator; no publisher-composite decomposition
aggregationContract.compensability: Arithmetic aggregation allows lower pressure on one input to offset higher pressure elsewhere; no bottleneck, veto or causal interpretation
aggregationContract.missingOrInvalidInput: Fail the whole run on missing/non-numeric/non-finite/out-of-range pressure, changed membership/year/method or source drift. No omission, zero-fill, per-region weight redistribution, clipping or source replacement
aggregationContract.invalidWeightPolicy: Require positive finite weights for all 18 frozen inputs, exact membership and budget sums within tolerance. Reject bad/zero/negative weights; never silently renormalize an invalid plan
aggregationContract.precisionPolicy: Full stored pressure and full-precision rational/cohort-variance shares; round only display. Sum weights within 1e-12; compare floating score identities within 1e-10. No score clipping or pre-ranking rounding
aggregationContract.provisionalRankPolicy: Rank 1 = highest provisional pressure; average descending ranks for exactly equal unrounded scores. Region results stay in frozen registry order, not sorted as a public league table
aggregationContract.interpretation: Relative 27-region 2023 pressure under declared normative budgets; not absolute quality of life, government performance, causal effect or a policy target

rationale: Dimension importance is independent of indicator count, unlike the global 1/18 benchmark.
No elicited expert/policy or external calibration evidence justifies unequal normative dimension budgets.
Within-dimension variance is dispersion, not social importance or reliability; data-driven reweighting is diagnostic only.
Hierarchy and accepted-overlap budget alternatives show limited displacement without establishing that any audited input is duplicate.
Weighting is not uniquely identified by these data; material sensitivity and covariance concentration remain disclosed rather than optimized away.

conceptualDiagnostics.overlapPolicy: Retain the freeze's distinct estimands and accepted overlap. No automatic correlation bonus, duplicate parent, inverse-correlation weight rule or source-composite component is added.
conceptualDiagnostics.varianceConcentrationPolicy: Equal normative dimension budgets do not imply equal observed variance contribution. Negative covariance shares are cancellation, not negative weights or beneficial pressure. Do not fit budgets to equalize this cohort's variance or desired ranks.

limitations: Weights express a transparent normative equal-importance assumption, not uniquely estimated truth or stakeholder consensus.
The 27-region cohort is small; high score correlation does not guarantee stable individual positions or statistically significant ranks.

Education and IRBI account for more of observed score variance than their nominal shares; Environment offsets some common regional pattern. These are ecological covariance facts, not grounds to reverse direction or discard a domain.
The normalization's endpoint sensitivity and survey/model uncertainty remain; coefficient-scaled diagnostics are not propagated confidence intervals.
All provisional scores/ranks exist only to validate weighting choices. Production cutover, independent validation, rights and release approval remain separate.
